question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: It is time to wind up the business.
options: It is time for the business to be wound up.
It is time that the business is wound up.
The time has come for the business to wind up.
It is time to be winding up the business.
answer: It is time for the business to be wound up.
explanation: चरण 1: 'It is time' वाले वाक्यों में Passive संरचना 'It is time + for + object + to be + V3' होती है। चरण 2: यहाँ object 'the business' है। चरण 3: Infinitive 'to wind up' को 'to be wound up' में बदलें। चरण 4: सभी भागों को सही क्रम में रखें।
trick: छात्र अक्सर 'for' का प्रयोग भूल जाते हैं और सीधे 'to be' चुन लेते हैं, जो गलत है।
tip: It is time + for + Object + to be + V3

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: I remember my sister taking me to the museum.
options: I remember I was taken to the museum by my sister.
I remember being taken to the museum by my sister.
I remember myself being taken to the museum.
My sister taking me to the museum is remembered by me.
answer: I remember being taken to the museum by my sister.
explanation: चरण 1: वाक्य में Gerund 'taking' का प्रयोग हुआ है। चरण 2: Gerund का passive 'being + V3' (being taken) होता है। चरण 3: Subject 'I' और verb 'remember' अपरिवर्तित रहेंगे। चरण 4: 'by my sister' को अंत में जोड़ें।
trick: Gerund (v1+ing) को Passive में हमेशा 'being + V3' में बदला जाता है, न कि 'was taken' में।
tip: Gerund Passive = being + V3

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: People say that the earth is a sphere.
options: That the earth is a sphere is said by people.
The earth is said to be a sphere.
It was said that the earth is a sphere.
The earth is being said to be a sphere.
answer: The earth is said to be a sphere.
explanation: चरण 1: 'People say that...' वाले वाक्यों को 'It is said that...' या 'Subject + is said to be...' से बनाया जाता है। चरण 2: यहाँ 'The earth' को Subject बनाएँ। चरण 3: 'say' को 'is said' में बदलें। चरण 4: 'is' को infinitive 'to be' में बदलें।
trick: अस्पष्ट कर्ता (People) को हटा दिया जाता है और 'to be' infinitive का प्रयोग सबसे सटीक माना जाता है।
tip: Subject + is/are said + to be + noun/adjective

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Circumstances will oblige me to go.
options: I will oblige to go by circumstances.
I shall be obliged to go.
Under circumstances, I should go.
I would be obliged to go by circumstances.
answer: I shall be obliged to go.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'me' को Subject 'I' में बदलें। चरण 2: Future tense 'will oblige' को 'shall/will be obliged' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'oblige' के साथ passive में 'by circumstances' आमतौर पर छिपा (hidden) रहता है। चरण 4: Infinitive 'to go' यथावत रहेगा।
trick: I के साथ 'shall' का प्रयोग व्याकरणिक रूप से अधिक सटीक है और 'by circumstances' को हटाना advanced passive का हिस्सा है।
tip: Obliged के साथ agent अक्सर छिपा रहता है।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Women like men to flatter them.
options: Women like to be flattered by men.
Women are liked to be flattered by men.
Men are liked by women to flatter them.
Women like that men should flatter them.
answer: Women like to be flattered by men.
explanation: चरण 1: वाक्य का मुख्य Subject 'Women' है, जो flattery का लक्ष्य भी हैं (them)। चरण 2: 'to flatter' (infinitive) को 'to be flattered' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'men' को agent 'by men' बना दें। चरण 4: अर्थ को बिना बदले संरचना को संक्षिप्त करें।
trick: जब मुख्य Subject और infinitive का object समान (Women = them) हो, तो pronoun को हटाकर सीधा infinitive passive बनाते हैं।
tip: Subject + like + to be + V3 + by agent

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Quinine tastes bitter.
options: Quinine is bitter when it is tasted.
Quinine is tasted bitter.
Quinine has a bitter taste.
Quinine was bitter when tasted.
answer: Quinine is bitter when it is tasted.
explanation: चरण 1: यह 'Subject + Verb + Adjective' वाली विशेष संरचना है। चरण 2: इसका Passive 'Subject + is/are + Adjective + when + it is/they are + V3' होता है। चरण 3: Tense present है, इसलिए 'is' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 4: 'tastes' का V3 'tasted' लगाएं।
trick: 'is tasted bitter' गलत है; सही अर्थ के लिए 'when it is' जोड़ना अनिवार्य है।
tip: Subject + is + Adjective + when it is + V3

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: He decided to sell the house.
options: He decided the house to be sold.
It was decided to sell the house by him.
He decided that the house should be sold.
The house was decided to be sold.
answer: He decided that the house should be sold.
explanation: चरण 1: Verb 'decide' के बाद infinitive आने पर noun clause का प्रयोग बेहतर होता है। चरण 2: 'decide' को यथावत रखें। चरण 3: 'that' conjunction लगाएँ। चरण 4: Object 'the house' के साथ 'should be + V3' (sold) का प्रयोग करें।
trick: 'decided the house to be sold' गलत व्याकरण है; 'that... should be' क्लॉज सबसे सटीक है।
tip: Decide/Agree + that + Subject + should be + V3

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: The box contains ten cigars.
options: Ten cigars are contained by the box.
Ten cigars are contained in the box.
Ten cigars have been contained in the box.
The box is contained with ten cigars.
answer: Ten cigars are contained in the box.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'ten cigars' को Subject बनाएँ। चरण 2: Present tense के कारण 'are contained' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 3: Verb 'contain' के साथ Passive में preposition 'in' लगता है, न कि 'by'। चरण 4: 'the box' को अंत में रखें।
trick: Contain के साथ हमेशा 'in' का प्रयोग होता है, 'by' का नहीं। यह Prepositional fix का मामला है।
tip: Contained के साथ 'in' का प्रयोग करें, 'by' का नहीं।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: I made him wash my car.
options: He was made wash my car by me.
My car was washed by him made by me.
He was made to wash my car.
I had my car washed by him.
answer: He was made to wash my car.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Make' एक Causative verb है जो Active में bare infinitive (बिना 'to' के V1) लेता है। चरण 2: Passive में 'make' के साथ पूर्ण infinitive (to + V1) का प्रयोग होता है। चरण 3: Object 'him' को 'He' में बदलें। चरण 4: 'was made to wash' लगाएँ ('by me' छुपा सकते हैं)।
trick: Active में 'make + V1', लेकिन Passive में हमेशा 'made + to + V1' होता है।
tip: Causative Passive: be made + to + V1

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Who taught you French?
options: By whom were you taught French?
By who were you taught French?
Who were you taught French by?
Both A and C are correct.
answer: Both A and C are correct.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Who' वाले प्रश्न 'By whom' से शुरू हो सकते हैं। चरण 2: 'By whom were you taught French?' एक मानक रूप है। चरण 3: आधुनिक अंग्रेजी में 'Who' को शुरू में रखकर preposition 'by' को अंत में भी रखा जा सकता है ('Who were you taught French by?'). चरण 4: अतः दोनों सही हैं।
trick: परीक्षाओं में 'By whom' और वाक्य के अंत में 'by' वाली संरचना दोनों मान्य होती हैं, विकल्पों को ध्यान से देखें।
tip: Who...by? और By whom...? दोनों मान्य हैं।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: We expect good news.
options: Good news is expected by us.
Good news is expected.
It is expected that good news will come.
Good news was expected.
answer: Good news is expected.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'Good news' को Subject बनाएँ। चरण 2: Present tense के अनुसार 'is expected' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 3: 'By us' जैसे सर्वनाम agents को Passive voice में अक्सर अनावश्यक मानकर हटा (hide) दिया जाता है। चरण 4: सबसे संक्षिप्त और सटीक विकल्प चुनें।
trick: 'By us' वाला विकल्प व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत नहीं है, लेकिन उन्नत स्तर पर 'Hidden Agent' वाले विकल्प को प्राथमिकता दी जाती है।
tip: Obvious agents (us, people) को हटा दें।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: One must do one's duty.
options: Duty must be done.
One's duty must be done.
Duty must be done by one.
One must have done duty.
answer: Duty must be done.
explanation: चरण 1: 'One' एक अनिश्चित सर्वनाम (indefinite pronoun) है। चरण 2: Passive में 'One' और 'one's' को पूरी तरह से हटा दिया जाता है। चरण 3: Object 'duty' को Subject बनाएँ। चरण 4: Modal 'must' के साथ 'be + V3' (must be done) लगाएँ।
trick: 'One's duty' लिखना गलत है क्योंकि passive में सामान्य अर्थ के लिए अधिकारवाचक शब्द भी हट जाता है।
tip: Indefinite subjects (One/Someone) को पूरी तरह हटा दें।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: They are to buy a new car.
options: A new car is to be bought by them.
A new car is being bought by them.
A new car has to be bought by them.
They have to buy a new car.
answer: A new car is to be bought by them.
explanation: चरण 1: संरचना 'is/am/are + to + V1' (infinitive of purpose) है। चरण 2: Passive में इसे 'is/am/are + to be + V3' में बदलें। चरण 3: Object 'a new car' Subject बनेगा, इसलिए 'is' लगेगा। चरण 4: 'to buy' को 'to be bought' में बदलें।
trick: इसे Continuous tense समझकर 'being' न लगाएँ। यह Infinitive का सीधा रूपांतरण है।
tip: to + V1 को to be + V3 में बदलें।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Rose smells sweet.
options: Rose is sweet when it smells.
Rose is sweet when it is smelt.
Rose is smelt sweet.
Rose was sweet when smelt.
answer: Rose is sweet when it is smelt.
explanation: चरण 1: Stative verb 'smell' और adjective 'sweet' का प्रयोग। चरण 2: 'Subject + is + Adjective + when it is + V3' का नियम लागू करें। चरण 3: 'Rose is sweet' लिखें। चरण 4: 'when it is smelt' (smell का V3) जोड़ें।
trick: क्रिया का तीसरा रूप (V3) 'smelt' या 'smelled' दोनों हो सकता है, लेकिन 'when it is' संरचना अनिवार्य है।
tip: Stative Verbs + Adjective का विशेष Passive नियम।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: There is no time to lose.
options: There is no time to be lost.
Time is not to be lost.
No time is there to be lost.
There has no time to be lost.
answer: There is no time to be lost.
explanation: चरण 1: 'There is/are + Noun + to + V1' वाली संरचना की पहचान करें। चरण 2: इस वाक्य में शुरुआती हिस्सा 'There is no time' बिल्कुल नहीं बदलता है। चरण 3: केवल Infinitive 'to lose' को Passive 'to be lost' में बदला जाता है। चरण 4: दोनों को जोड़ दें।
trick: वाक्य के Subject या 'There is' को बदलने की कोशिश न करें, केवल अंत के infinitive को बदलें।
tip: There is/are... + to be + V3

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Your conduct surprised me.
options: I was surprised by your conduct.
I was surprised at your conduct.
Your conduct was surprised by me.
I have been surprised at your conduct.
answer: I was surprised at your conduct.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'me' को 'I' में बदलें। चरण 2: Past tense 'surprised' को 'was surprised' में बदलें। चरण 3: Verb 'surprise' के साथ Passive voice में 'by' का नहीं, बल्कि 'at' का प्रयोग होता है। चरण 4: 'at your conduct' लगाएँ।
trick: Surprised, astonished, amazed के साथ हमेशा 'at' का प्रयोग करें, 'by' का नहीं।
tip: Surprised takes 'at' instead of 'by'.

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: I want someone to take photographs.
options: I want photographs to be taken.
I want someone to be taken photographs.
Photographs are wanted to be taken by someone.
I want photographs taking.
answer: I want photographs to be taken.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Subject + want + object + to + V1' संरचना। चरण 2: यहाँ 'someone' एक अनिश्चित कर्ता है जिसे हटा दिया जाएगा। चरण 3: 'want' के बाद वाले object 'photographs' को आगे लाएँ। चरण 4: 'to take' को 'to be taken' में बदलें।
trick: 'someone' को पूरी तरह से हटा देना चाहिए और 'want' को passive नहीं बनाना चाहिए।
tip: Subject + want + Object + to be + V3

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: He gave me a book.
options: A book was given to me by him.
I was given a book by him.
Both A and B are correct.
A book is given to me by him.
answer: Both A and B are correct.
explanation: चरण 1: इस वाक्य में दो Objects हैं: 'me' (Indirect) और 'a book' (Direct)। चरण 2: Indirect object से: 'I was given a book by him.' चरण 3: Direct object से: 'A book was given to me by him.' (यहाँ 'to' लगाना अनिवार्य है)। चरण 4: दोनों संरचनाएँ व्याकरणिक रूप से सही हैं।
trick: Ditransitive verbs (give, send, tell) के दो passive रूप होते हैं। Direct object को subject बनाने पर preposition 'to/for' लगता है।
tip: दो Objects = दो प्रकार के Passive संभव।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Let him do this work.
options: Let this work be done by him.
Let this work done by him.
This work should be done by him.
Let him be done this work.
answer: Let this work be done by him.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Let' से शुरू होने वाले Imperative वाक्यों की Passive संरचना 'Let + Object + be + V3 + by + Agent' होती है। चरण 2: Object 'this work' को Let के बाद रखें। चरण 3: 'be + done' लगाएँ। चरण 4: अंत में 'by him' जोड़ें।
trick: Imperative वाक्यों में 'Let' के साथ हमेशा 'be' का प्रयोग होता है, इसे भूलना आम गलती है।
tip: Let + Object + be + V3 + by agent

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Nobody has answered my question.
options: My question has been answered by nobody.
My question has not been answered.
My question was not answered.
Nobody has been answered my question.
answer: My question has not been answered.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Nobody' एक नकारात्मक subject है। चरण 2: Object 'my question' Subject बनेगा। चरण 3: 'has answered' को 'has not been answered' में बदलें (Nobody की नकारात्मकता को 'not' में बदलें)। चरण 4: 'by nobody' लिखना व्याकरणिक रूप से भद्दा (awkward) माना जाता है, इसलिए इसे हटा दें।
trick: नकारात्मक अनिश्चित सर्वनाम (Nobody, None) को हटाकर Helping Verb के साथ 'not' लगाएँ।
tip: Nobody/None को 'not' में बदलें और agent हटा दें।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: The news alarmed us.
options: We were alarmed by the news.
We were alarmed at the news.
We are alarmed at the news.
The news was alarmed by us.
answer: We were alarmed at the news.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'us' को 'We' में बदलें। चरण 2: Past tense 'alarmed' को 'were alarmed' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'Alarm' क्रिया के साथ Passive voice में 'at' preposition का प्रयोग होता है, 'by' का नहीं। चरण 4: 'at the news' लगाएँ।
trick: Alarmed, shocked, startled के साथ 'at' का प्रयोग होता है, जो 'by' वाले विकल्प को गलत बनाता है।
tip: Alarmed takes 'at', not 'by'.

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: I saw him leaving the house.
options: He was seen leaving the house by me.
He was seen to leave the house by me.
Leaving the house was seen by him.
He had been seen leaving the house.
answer: He was seen leaving the house by me.
explanation: चरण 1: 'See' + Object + Present Participle (V1+ing) वाली संरचना। चरण 2: Object 'him' को 'He' बनाएँ। चरण 3: 'saw' को 'was seen' में बदलें। चरण 4: Participle 'leaving the house' को ज्यों का त्यों रखें। इसमें 'to' नहीं जुड़ता।
trick: अगर Active में 'bare infinitive' (I saw him go) हो, तो Passive में 'to' लगता है (He was seen to go), लेकिन Participle (leaving) नहीं बदलता।
tip: Present Participle (v1+ing) Passive में नहीं बदलता।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: We must endure what we cannot cure.
options: What we cannot cure must be endured.
What cannot be cured must be endured.
What cannot cure must be endured by us.
What is not cured must be endured.
answer: What cannot be cured must be endured.
explanation: चरण 1: यह एक Complex sentence है जिसमें दो clauses हैं और दोनों का Passive बनेगा। चरण 2: 'what we cannot cure' (Noun clause) को 'What cannot be cured' में बदलें ('we' hidden agent)। चरण 3: 'We must endure' को 'must be endured' में बदलें। चरण 4: दोनों को जोड़ें।
trick: परीक्षा में अक्सर केवल एक भाग का Passive बना हुआ विकल्प देते हैं, दोनों भागों का Passive बनना चाहिए।
tip: Complex वाक्यों में दोनों Clauses का Passive बनाएँ।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: They elected him President.
options: He was elected President by them.
President was elected to him.
He was elected as President by them.
They were elected President by him.
answer: He was elected President by them.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Him' Object है और 'President' Object Complement है। चरण 2: केवल Object (He) Subject बन सकता है, Complement नहीं। चरण 3: 'elected' को 'was elected' में बदलें। चरण 4: 'President' बिना किसी preposition या 'as' के सीधा आएगा।
trick: Elected, selected, appointed के बाद 'as' का प्रयोग व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत होता है।
tip: Object Complement के साथ 'as' का प्रयोग न करें।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Please enter by the left door.
options: You are requested to enter by the left door.
Let the left door be entered.
The left door is requested to be entered.
You are ordered to enter by the left door.
answer: You are requested to enter by the left door.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Please' वाले वाक्य Imperative (निवेदन) होते हैं जिनमें Object नहीं होता (Intransitive verb 'enter')। चरण 2: ऐसे वाक्यों का Passive 'You are requested to' से शुरू होता है। चरण 3: 'Please' को हटा दें। चरण 4: बाकी वाक्य 'enter by the left door' ज्यों का त्यों जोड़ दें।
trick: अकर्मक क्रिया (Intransitive) का Passive 'Let' से नहीं बन सकता, 'You are requested/ordered to' ही एकमात्र उपाय है।
tip: Please/Kindly = You are requested to + V1

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: I know him.
options: He is known by me.
He is known to me.
He was known to me.
He has been known to me.
answer: He is known to me.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'him' को 'He' में बदलें। चरण 2: Present tense 'know' को 'is known' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'Know' क्रिया के साथ Passive voice में 'to' preposition लगता है, 'by' नहीं। चरण 4: 'to me' जोड़ें।
trick: Know और Oblige के साथ हमेशा 'to' का प्रयोग होता है। 'by' वाला विकल्प ट्रैप है।
tip: Known हमेशा 'to' लेता है, 'by' नहीं।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: The judge found him guilty of murder.
options: He was found guilty of murder by the judge.
Guilty of murder was found by the judge.
He was found to be guilty of murder by the judge.
The judge was found guilty of murder.
answer: He was found guilty of murder by the judge.
explanation: चरण 1: 'him' (Object) को Subject 'He' बनाएँ। चरण 2: 'guilty of murder' (Object complement) अपनी जगह रहेगा। चरण 3: Past verb 'found' को 'was found' में बदलें। चरण 4: 'guilty of murder' जोड़कर अंत में 'by the judge' लगाएँ।
trick: Complement 'guilty' को Subject बनाने की कोशिश न करें, केवल मुख्य Object (him) को आगे लाएँ।
tip: Object Complement अपनी जगह पर ही रहता है।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Has someone made all the necessary arrangements?
options: Have all the necessary arrangements been made by someone?
Has all the necessary arrangements been made?
Have all the necessary arrangements been made?
Are all the necessary arrangements made?
answer: Have all the necessary arrangements been made?
explanation: चरण 1: Interrogative वाक्य। 'all the necessary arrangements' (Plural Object) को Subject बनाएँ। चरण 2: Plural के लिए 'Have' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 3: Present perfect में 'been + V3' (been made) लगाएँ। चरण 4: अनिश्चित कर्ता 'someone' को (by someone) हटा दें।
trick: वाक्य की शुरुआत 'Has' से हुई है, लेकिन नया Subject Plural है, इसलिए 'Have' का प्रयोग होगा।
tip: नये Subject के अनुसार Helping Verb (Has/Have) चुनें।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: They say he is a spy.
options: It is said that he is a spy.
He is said to be a spy.
Both A and B are correct.
A spy is said to be him.
answer: Both A and B are correct.
explanation: चरण 1: 'They say...' संरचना। इसे दो तरह से Passive में बदला जा सकता है। चरण 2: Impersonal passive: 'It is said that he is a spy.' (that-clause ज्यों का त्यों)। चरण 3: Personal passive: 'He is said to be a spy.' (he को subject बनाकर infinitive 'to be' का प्रयोग)। चरण 4: अतः दोनों सही हैं।
trick: परीक्षा में Personal passive (He is said...) को अधिक उन्नत माना जाता है, लेकिन दोनों व्याकरणिक रूप से पूर्णतः शुद्ध हैं।
tip: Say/Believe/Report के दो Passive रूप होते हैं।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: I have to finish this work today.
options: This work has to be finished by me today.
This work have to be finished today.
This work is to be finished by me today.
Today this work has been finished by me.
answer: This work has to be finished by me today.
explanation: चरण 1: 'have to + V1' (Obligation) संरचना। चरण 2: Passive में इसे 'has/have to be + V3' में बदलें। चरण 3: Object 'This work' Singular है, इसलिए 'has to be finished' लगेगा। चरण 4: 'by me today' जोड़ें।
trick: नये Subject के अनुसार 'have to' को 'has to' में बदलना न भूलें।
tip: has/have/had to + be + V3

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: One should not mock at the poor.
options: The poor should not be mocked.
The poor should not be mocked at.
The poor should not been mocked at by one.
The poor should not mock at.
answer: The poor should not be mocked at.
explanation: चरण 1: 'mock at' एक Prepositional verb है, Passive में Preposition साथ ही रहता है। चरण 2: 'The poor' को Subject बनाएँ। चरण 3: Modal 'should not' के साथ 'be + mocked at' लगाएँ। चरण 4: 'One' अनिश्चित कर्ता होने के कारण 'by one' हटा दें।
trick: Preposition 'at' को हटाना सबसे आम गलती है; क्रिया के साथ जुड़ा preposition हमेशा برقرار रहता है।
tip: Prepositional verbs अपना preposition नहीं छोड़ते।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: It is your duty to make tea at eleven o'clock.
options: You are supposed to make tea at eleven o'clock.
Tea is to be made at eleven o'clock by you.
It is expected of you to make tea at eleven o'clock.
Both A and C are correct.
answer: Both A and C are correct.
explanation: चरण 1: 'It is your duty' वाले वाक्यों का अर्थ 'obligation' या 'expectation' होता है। चरण 2: इन्हें 'You are supposed to...' या 'It is expected of you to...' में बदला जा सकता है। चरण 3: 'make tea' infinitive समान रहता है। चरण 4: दोनों विकल्प अर्थ और संरचना में सही हैं।
trick: Duty वाले वाक्यों में 'supposed to' या 'expected' का प्रयोग advanced voice transformation का हिस्सा है।
tip: Duty = Supposed to / Expected to

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: What did he do?
options: What was done by him?
What did done by him?
What had been done by him?
What is done by him?
answer: What was done by him?
explanation: चरण 1: 'What' यहाँ Object का कार्य कर रहा है, इसलिए यही Passive का Subject बनेगा। चरण 2: Past Indefinite (did) को 'was/were + V3' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'What' के साथ Singular Verb 'was' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 4: 'do' का V3 'done' और अंत में 'by him' लगाएँ।
trick: छात्र 'What' के साथ Subject ढूँढने लगते हैं, जबकि 'What' स्वयं Subject बन जाता है।
tip: What स्वयं Subject बनकर was/is + V3 लेता है।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: He wants people to respect him.
options: He wants to be respected by people.
He wants to be respected.
People are wanted to respect him.
Both A and B are correct (B is preferred).
answer: Both A and B are correct (B is preferred).
explanation: चरण 1: 'want + object + to + V1' संरचना। चरण 2: जब Subject (He) और Infinitive का Object (him) समान हों, तो 'to be + V3' का प्रयोग होता है। चरण 3: 'He wants to be respected.' चरण 4: 'by people' को हटाना (hide करना) अधिक उचित माना जाता है, हालांकि A भी तकनीकी रूप से सही है।
trick: General agents (people, someone) को हटा देना हमेशा बेहतर (preferred) विकल्प होता है।
tip: Obvious agents को omit करें।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: The pot contains milk.
options: Milk is contained by the pot.
Milk is contained in the pot.
Milk has been contained in the pot.
The pot is contained with milk.
answer: Milk is contained in the pot.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'milk' को Subject बनाएँ। चरण 2: Present tense के अनुसार 'is contained' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 3: Verb 'contain' और 'embody' के साथ 'in' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'by' का। चरण 4: 'in the pot' जोड़ें।
trick: 'by' का प्रयोग यहाँ पूरी तरह गलत है, यह Preposition-based exception है।
tip: Contain हमेशा 'in' लेता है।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: We refused them admission.
options: Admission was refused to them.
They were refused admission.
Both A and B are correct.
They refused admission by us.
answer: Both A and B are correct.
explanation: चरण 1: दो Objects (them - Indirect, admission - Direct)। चरण 2: 'They were refused admission' (Indirect को Subject बनाकर, जो अधिक प्राकृतिक है)। चरण 3: 'Admission was refused to them' (Direct को Subject बनाकर, 'to' जोड़ना अनिवार्य है)। चरण 4: अतः दोनों सही हैं।
trick: व्यक्तिगत (Indirect) Object को Subject बनाना अंग्रेजी में अधिक प्रचलन में है, लेकिन व्याकरणिक रूप से दोनों सही हैं।
tip: Direct Object आगे आए तो 'to' लगाएँ।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Do not insult the weak.
options: Let the weak not be insulted.
The weak should not be insulted.
Both A and B are correct.
You are requested not to insult the weak.
answer: Both A and B are correct.
explanation: चरण 1: Negative Imperative वाक्य। चरण 2: 'Let' का प्रयोग: 'Let + object + not + be + V3' (Let the weak not be insulted)। चरण 3: 'Should' का प्रयोग (नैतिक सलाह): 'Object + should not be + V3' (The weak should not be insulted)। चरण 4: दोनों संरचनाएँ मान्य हैं।
trick: नैतिक सलाह (Moral advice) वाले वाक्यों में 'should' वाला विकल्प 'Let' से अधिक बेहतर माना जाता है, लेकिन दोनों सही हैं।
tip: Let...not be या Should not be

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: His behavior disgusted me.
options: I was disgusted by his behavior.
I was disgusted with his behavior.
I was disgusted at his behavior.
His behavior was disgusted by me.
answer: I was disgusted with his behavior.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'me' को 'I' में बदलें। चरण 2: 'disgusted' (Past) को 'was disgusted' करें। चरण 3: 'Disgust', 'please', 'satisfy' जैसी भावनाओं/व्यवहार को दर्शाने वाली क्रियाओं के साथ (किसी चीज़/व्यवहार के लिए) 'with' का प्रयोग होता है। चरण 4: 'with his behavior' लगाएँ।
trick: यहाँ 'at' और 'with' दोनों आ सकते हैं, लेकिन व्यवहार (behavior) या व्यक्ति के साथ 'with' अधिक सटीक माना जाता है।
tip: Disgusted/Pleased with (something/someone).

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: It is impossible to do this.
options: This is impossible to be done.
To do this is impossible.
It is impossible for this to be done.
This impossible is to be done.
answer: This is impossible to be done.
explanation: चरण 1: 'It is + adjective + to + V1 + Object' संरचना। चरण 2: Object 'this' को Subject की जगह लाएँ। चरण 3: 'is impossible' को समान रखें। चरण 4: Infinitive 'to do' को 'to be done' में बदलें।
trick: यद्यपि 'It is impossible for this to be done' भी बन सकता है, 'This is impossible to be done' सबसे मानक (standard) रूप है।
tip: Object + is + Adj + to be + V3

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: I have bought a house to live in.
options: A house has been bought to live in by me.
A house has been bought by me to be lived in.
To live in a house has been bought.
A house is bought to be lived in by me.
answer: A house has been bought by me to be lived in.
explanation: चरण 1: Main verb (have bought) और Infinitive (to live in) दोनों का Passive बनेगा। चरण 2: 'A house has been bought by me' (Main clause)। चरण 3: 'to live in' को 'to be lived in' में बदलें (Preposition 'in' साथ रहेगा)। चरण 4: दोनों को जोड़ें।
trick: केवल मुख्य क्रिया को बदलना पर्याप्त नहीं है, infinitive का भी Passive 'to be lived in' बनाना होगा।
tip: Infinitive + Preposition = to be + V3 + Prep

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Prepare yourself for the worst.
options: You be prepared for the worst.
Let yourself be prepared for the worst.
Be prepared for the worst.
The worst should be prepared by you.
answer: Be prepared for the worst.
explanation: चरण 1: Reflexive pronoun (yourself) वाले Imperative वाक्य में सीधा 'Be + V3' का प्रयोग किया जाता है। चरण 2: 'Prepare' को 'Be prepared' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'yourself' को हटा दें क्योंकि अर्थ स्वतः स्पष्ट है। चरण 4: 'for the worst' जोड़ दें।
trick: 'Let yourself be prepared' बहुत अटपटा (awkward) है; 'Be prepared' सबसे प्राकृतिक और सही Passive है।
tip: Verb + yourself = Be + V3

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: A storm damaged the roof.
options: The roof was damaged by a storm.
The roof was damaged in a storm.
The roof had been damaged by a storm.
Both A and B are acceptable.
answer: Both A and B are acceptable.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'the roof' Subject बनेगा। चरण 2: 'damaged' 'was damaged' में बदलेगा। चरण 3: प्राकृतिक घटनाओं के लिए 'by a storm' (agent के रूप में) और 'in a storm' (परिस्थिति के रूप में) दोनों का प्रयोग व्याकरणिक रूप से सही माना जाता है।
trick: प्राकृतिक आपदाओं के साथ 'in' का प्रयोग अधिक स्वाभाविक लगता है, लेकिन 'by' तकनीकी रूप से गलत नहीं है।
tip: Natural forces can take 'by' or 'in'.

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: We saw the tree fall.
options: The tree was seen fall by us.
The tree was seen to fall.
The tree fell and was seen.
The tree was seen falling.
answer: The tree was seen to fall.
explanation: चरण 1: 'See' + bare infinitive (fall) वाली संरचना। चरण 2: Object 'the tree' को आगे लाएँ। चरण 3: 'saw' को 'was seen' करें। चरण 4: Passive में bare infinitive 'fall' को full infinitive 'to fall' में बदलना अनिवार्य है। 'By us' छिपा दें।
trick: Active में 'to' नहीं था, लेकिन Passive में 'to fall' लगाना सबसे महत्वपूर्ण नियम है।
tip: Bare Infinitive Passive में 'to' लेता है।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: I remember them taking me to the zoo.
options: I remember being taken to the zoo.
I remember to be taken to the zoo.
I remember I was taken to the zoo.
Taking me to the zoo is remembered.
answer: I remember being taken to the zoo.
explanation: चरण 1: 'taking' Gerund है। चरण 2: Gerund का passive 'being + V3' होता है। चरण 3: Subject 'I' और 'remember' समान रहेंगे। चरण 4: 'them' (agent) को हटा दें क्योंकि यह अनिश्चित/सामान्य है।
trick: यहाँ 'them' को 'by them' के रूप में नहीं लिखा जाता, इसे omit करना ही advanced grammar है।
tip: Gerund का Passive = being + V3

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: The child's performance fascinated them.
options: They were fascinated by the child's performance.
They were fascinated with the child's performance.
They were fascinated at the child's performance.
Both B and C are correct.
answer: Both B and C are correct.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Fascinate' क्रिया। चरण 2: Object 'them' 'They were' में बदलेगा। चरण 3: किसी चीज़ (performance) पर मोहित होने के लिए 'with' या 'at' दोनों Prepositions मान्य हैं, लेकिन 'by' से बचा जाता है। चरण 4: 'with/at the child's performance' लगाएँ।
trick: Fascinated, charmed, enchanted के साथ 'with' (व्यक्ति के लिए) या 'at/with' (चीज़/प्रदर्शन के लिए) लगता है।
tip: Fascinated takes 'with' or 'at'.

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: He likes people to call him 'Sir'.
options: He likes to be called 'Sir' by people.
He likes being called 'Sir'.
He likes to be called 'Sir'.
Both B and C are correct depending on context, but C matches the infinitive structure.
answer: Both B and C are correct depending on context, but C matches the infinitive structure.
explanation: चरण 1: Active में infinitive 'to call' है। चरण 2: इसका सीधा रूपांतरण 'to be called' होगा (He likes to be called 'Sir')। चरण 3: Like के साथ gerund भी आ सकता है (He likes being called 'Sir') जो अर्थ में समान है। चरण 4: 'by people' को हटा दें।
trick: Like/Love/Hate के बाद infinitive या gerund दोनों आ सकते हैं, इसलिए दोनों Passive रूप मान्य हो जाते हैं।
tip: Like + to be V3 / being V3 दोनों सही हैं।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Women use cosmetics to look beautiful.
options: Cosmetics are used by women to look beautiful.
Cosmetics are used to look beautiful by women.
To look beautiful, cosmetics are used by women.
All of the above.
answer: All of the above.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'cosmetics' को Subject बनाएँ (Cosmetics are used)। चरण 2: 'by women' एजेंट लगाएँ। चरण 3: Infinitive phrase 'to look beautiful' एक Adverbial of purpose है, जिसे वाक्य के मध्य, अंत या शुरू में रखा जा सकता है। चरण 4: अतः सभी विकल्प सही हैं।
trick: Adverbial phrases (to look beautiful) की जगह (position) वाक्य में लचीली होती है, यह संरचना को गलत नहीं बनाता।
tip: Adverbial of purpose की position flexible है।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Your prompt reply will highly oblige me.
options: I will be highly obliged by your prompt reply.
I shall be highly obliged to your prompt reply.
I shall be highly obliged by your prompt reply.
I shall be highly obliged at your prompt reply.
answer: I will be highly obliged by your prompt reply.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'me' को 'I' में बदलें। चरण 2: Future 'will' के साथ 'be obliged' लगाएँ। चरण 3: Oblige के साथ 'to' तब लगता है जब कोई व्यक्ति (person) हो, लेकिन किसी चीज़/कार्य (reply) के लिए 'by' का प्रयोग होता है। चरण 4: 'by your prompt reply' सही है।
trick: Obliged to a person, but obliged by a thing/action. यह सबसे बारीक अंतर है जो CAT/SBI PO में पूछा जाता है।
tip: Obliged to (person), Obliged by (thing/action).

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: We expect that they will win the match.
options: It is expected that they will win the match.
It is expected that the match will be won by them.
They are expected to win the match.
All of the above are correct passive forms.
answer: All of the above are correct passive forms.
explanation: चरण 1: यह Complex sentence है। चरण 2: केवल Main clause का Passive: 'It is expected that they will win the match.' चरण 3: दोनों Clauses का Passive: 'It is expected that the match will be won by them.' चरण 4: Personal Passive (advanced): 'They are expected to win the match.'
trick: Expect/Believe वाले वाक्यों में तीन प्रकार के Passive बन सकते हैं। परीक्षा में कोई भी दिया जा सकता है।
tip: Complex वाक्यों के कई मान्य Passive होते हैं।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: He gave me a pen to write with.
options: I was given a pen by him to write with.
A pen was given to me by him to write with.
A pen to write with was given to me by him.
All of the above.
answer: All of the above.
explanation: चरण 1: वाक्य में दो Objects (me, a pen) और एक Prepositional Infinitive (to write with) है। चरण 2: Indirect object से: I was given a pen... चरण 3: Direct object से: A pen was given to me... चरण 4: Infinitive phrase को Noun से जोड़कर: A pen to write with was given... सभी सही हैं।
trick: Infinitive + Preposition (to write with) को उसके Noun (a pen) के साथ चिपकाकर भी Subject बनाया जा सकता है।
tip: Prepositional infinitive वाक्य में कई जगह आ सकता है।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: I remember my father taking me to the theatre.
options: I remember my father being taken to the theatre.
I remember being taken to the theatre by my father.
I remember myself being taken to the theatre by my father.
I remember to have been taken to the theatre by my father.
answer: I remember being taken to the theatre by my father.
explanation: चरण 1: वाक्य में 'taking' एक Gerund है। चरण 2: Gerund का Passive 'being + V3' (being taken) होता है। चरण 3: 'I remember' मुख्य उपवाक्य है, जो अपरिवर्तित रहेगा। चरण 4: 'my father' जो Active में agent है, उसे 'by my father' के रूप में अंत में जोड़ें।
trick: छात्र अक्सर 'to have been' (Perfect Infinitive) चुन लेते हैं, जबकि Gerund का सीधा Passive 'being + V3' होता है।
tip: Gerund (V1+ing) का Passive हमेशा 'being + V3' होता है।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: It is time to water the plants.
options: It is time for the plants to be watered.
The plants should be watered as it is time.
It is time the plants are watered.
It is time that the plants be watered.
answer: It is time for the plants to be watered.
explanation: चरण 1: 'It is time' वाले वाक्यों का प्रारंभिक भाग नहीं बदलता। चरण 2: Infinitive 'to water' के object 'the plants' से पहले 'for' लगाया जाता है। चरण 3: Infinitive को 'to be + V3' (to be watered) में बदलें। चरण 4: पूरी संरचना 'It is time + for + Object + to be + V3' बनती है।
trick: विकल्पों में 'should be' या 'are watered' भ्रामक हैं; सही संरचना हमेशा 'for + object + to be' होती है।
tip: 'It is time' के बाद हमेशा 'for + Object + to be + V3' लगाएं।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: They made him confess the crime.
options: He was made confess the crime by them.
He was made to confess the crime.
The crime was made to be confessed by him.
He made the crime confessed.
answer: He was made to confess the crime.
explanation: चरण 1: Active Voice में 'make' (Causative Verb) के बाद Bare Infinitive (confess) आता है। चरण 2: Passive Voice में 'make' के बाद Full Infinitive (to + V1) का प्रयोग होता है। चरण 3: Object 'him' को Subject 'He' में बदलें और 'made' को 'was made' करें। चरण 4: 'confess' को 'to confess' लिखें और 'by them' (Hidden Agent) को हटा दें।
trick: Active में 'to' नहीं होता, लेकिन Passive में 'was made to' लगाना अनिवार्य है।
tip: Passive Causative 'make' हमेशा 'to + V1' लेता है।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: There is no money to waste.
options: Money is not to be wasted there.
There is no money to be wasted.
To waste money is not there.
No money is there to be wasted.
answer: There is no money to be wasted.
explanation: चरण 1: 'There + verb + noun + infinitive' संरचना वाले वाक्यों में केवल Infinitive भाग बदलता है। चरण 2: 'There is no money' को ज्यों का त्यों रखें। चरण 3: Active Infinitive 'to waste' को Passive 'to be wasted' में बदलें। चरण 4: दोनों भागों को जोड़कर अंतिम वाक्य बनाएं।
trick: छात्र अक्सर 'There' को हटाकर 'Money' को Subject बनाने का प्रयास करते हैं, जो गलत है।
tip: There वाले वाक्यों में केवल Infinitive (to be + V3) बदलें।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: People say that he is a genius.
options: It is said that he is a genius.
He is said to be a genius.
Both A and B are correct.
That he is a genius is said by people.
answer: Both A and B are correct.
explanation: चरण 1: 'People say that...' जैसे वाक्यों के दो Passive रूप होते हैं। चरण 2: पहला (Impersonal), 'It is said that' से शुरू होता है। चरण 3: दूसरा (Personal), subordinate clause के subject (he) को मुख्य subject बनाता है और infinitive (to be) का उपयोग करता है। चरण 4: चूँकि दोनों (A और B) व्याकरणिक रूप से सही हैं, इसलिए 'Both A and B' सही उत्तर है।
trick: परीक्षा में अक्सर केवल एक रूप दिया जाता है, लेकिन दोनों मान्य हैं। 'He is said to be...' अधिक उन्नत (Advanced) है।
tip: Verbs of reporting के Impersonal और Personal दोनों Passive बनते हैं।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: I have to finish this work today.
options: This work has to be finished today.
This work have to be finished today.
This work must be finished today by me.
Today this work has to finish.
answer: This work has to be finished today.
explanation: चरण 1: यह 'have to + V1' (Obligation) वाली संरचना है। चरण 2: Object 'This work' (Singular) को Subject बनाएं, इसलिए 'has to' का प्रयोग होगा। चरण 3: Infinitive 'to finish' को 'to be finished' में बदलें। चरण 4: 'by me' को अक्सर अनावश्यक मानकर हटा (Hidden Agent) दिया जाता है, विशेषकर जब समय (today) पर जोर हो।
trick: 'have to' को 'has to' में बदलना न भूलें, क्योंकि नया Subject 'This work' एकवचन है।
tip: Subject के अनुसार has/have to + be + V3 का प्रयोग करें।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: We expect good news.
options: Good news is expected by us.
Good news is expected.
It is expected of good news.
Good news expects us.
answer: Good news is expected.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'Good news' को Subject के स्थान पर लाएं। चरण 2: Present Indefinite Tense (expect) को 'is expected' में बदलें (Good news singular uncountable है)। चरण 3: 'We', 'They', 'People' जैसे सामान्य कर्ताओं को Passive में 'Hidden Agent' के रूप में हटा दिया जाता है। चरण 4: अतः 'by us' का प्रयोग न करना बेहतर है।
trick: 'by us' वाला विकल्प तकनीकी रूप से गलत नहीं है, लेकिन प्रतिस्पर्धी परीक्षाओं में बिना agent वाले विकल्प को प्राथमिकता दी जाती है।
tip: सामान्य सर्वनामों (We, They) को Passive में Hidden Agent बनाएं।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Women like men to flatter them.
options: Men are liked by women to flatter them.
Women like to be flattered by men.
Women like that men should flatter them.
Women are liked to be flattered by men.
answer: Women like to be flattered by men.
explanation: चरण 1: जब मुख्य Subject (Women) और Infinitive का Object (them) एक ही व्यक्ति/समूह हों, तो संरचना बदल जाती है। चरण 2: 'Women like' वाला भाग स्थिर रहता है। चरण 3: Infinitive 'to flatter' को Passive 'to be flattered' में बदलें। चरण 4: Active Infinitive के Subject (men) को 'by men' बनाकर अंत में रखें।
trick: अगर Subject और Infinitive का Object अलग-अलग हों, तो नियम अलग होता है। यहाँ दोनों समान (Women = them) हैं।
tip: समान Subject/Object होने पर: Subject + Verb + to be + V3 + by Agent.

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Quinine tastes bitter.
options: Quinine is tasted bitter.
Quinine is bitter when it is tasted.
Quinine has a bitter taste.
Bitter is tasted by quinine.
answer: Quinine is bitter when it is tasted.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Taste', 'smell', 'feel' जैसी Stative Verbs के साथ Adjective आने पर एक विशेष नियम लगता है। चरण 2: पहले 'Subject + is + Adjective' (Quinine is bitter) लिखें। चरण 3: फिर 'when it is/they are' जोड़ें। चरण 4: अंत में Verb का V3 (tasted) लगाएं।
trick: सीधे 'is tasted bitter' लिखना पूरी तरह से गलत व्याकरण है। 'when' क्लॉज आवश्यक है।
tip: Stative Verbs + Adjective: S + is/are + Adj + when it is + V3.

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: I saw him opening the box.
options: He was seen opening the box by me.
He was seen to open the box by me.
The box was seen being opened by him.
He was seen to opening the box.
answer: He was seen opening the box by me.
explanation: चरण 1: Verb of Perception (saw) के बाद Present Participle (opening) का प्रयोग हुआ है। चरण 2: Object 'him' को Subject 'He' में और 'saw' को 'was seen' में बदलें। चरण 3: Present Participle 'opening' Passive में अपरिवर्तित रहता है (इसे Infinitive में न बदलें)। चरण 4: अंत में 'the box by me' जोड़ें।
trick: अगर Active में Bare Infinitive (open) होता, तो Passive में 'to open' आता, लेकिन Participle (opening) नहीं बदलता।
tip: Passive में Present Participle (V1+ing) अपना रूप नहीं बदलता है।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: One must do one's duty.
options: Duty must be done.
One's duty must be done.
Duty must be done by one.
One must have done duty.
answer: Duty must be done.
explanation: चरण 1: 'One' एक Indefinite Pronoun है। चरण 2: Passive में Indefinite Pronoun (One, Someone, Nobody) को पूरी तरह से हटा दिया जाता है। चरण 3: 'one's' (Possessive) को भी हटा दें, केवल 'Duty' को Subject बनाएं। चरण 4: Modal 'must' के साथ 'be + V3' (must be done) लगाएं।
trick: 'One's duty' को Subject बनाना गलत है; Possessive case भी agent के साथ हट जाता है।
tip: Indefinite Pronouns और उनके Possessive रूप Passive में हटा दें।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: He decided to sell the house.
options: He decided the house to be sold.
It was decided to sell the house by him.
He decided that the house should be sold.
The house was decided to be sold.
answer: He decided that the house should be sold.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Decide', 'agree', 'determine' जैसी Verbs के बाद Infinitive आने पर 'that-clause' का प्रयोग बेहतर होता है। चरण 2: 'He decided' को ज्यों का त्यों रखें और 'that' लगाएं। चरण 3: Infinitive के Object 'the house' को Clause का Subject बनाएं। चरण 4: 'should be + V3' (should be sold) का प्रयोग कर Clause पूरा करें।
trick: 'decided the house to be sold' व्याकरणिक रूप से भद्दा (awkward) और गलत है।
tip: Decide/Agree + to V1 का Passive 'that ... should be V3' से बनाएं।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: The box contains ten cigars.
options: Ten cigars are contained by the box.
Ten cigars are contained in the box.
Ten cigars have been contained in the box.
The box is contained with ten cigars.
answer: Ten cigars are contained in the box.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'Ten cigars' को Subject बनाएं और Present Indefinite के अनुसार 'are contained' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 2: 'Contain' और 'Embody' जैसी Verbs के साथ Passive में 'by' का प्रयोग नहीं होता। चरण 3: इन Verbs के साथ हमेशा 'in' Preposition लगता है। चरण 4: अंत में 'in the box' जोड़ें।
trick: आदत के अनुसार 'by' लगाना एक आम ट्रैप है; 'contain' के साथ 'in' ही सही है।
tip: 'Contain' और 'Embody' के Passive में 'in' का प्रयोग करें, 'by' का नहीं।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: I want someone to take photographs.
options: I want photographs to be taken.
I want someone to be taken photographs.
Photographs are wanted to be taken by me.
I want photographs taking.
answer: I want photographs to be taken.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Want + Object (Agent) + to V1 + Object' संरचना है। चरण 2: 'I want' मुख्य क्लॉज है, यह नहीं बदलेगा। चरण 3: Infinitive के Object 'photographs' को 'want' के तुरंत बाद लाएं। चरण 4: 'to take' को 'to be taken' में बदलें और अनिश्चित कर्ता 'someone' को हटा दें।
trick: 'Photographs are wanted...' अर्थ को पूरी तरह बदल देता है, 'want' को Active ही रहने दें।
tip: Want/Wish के बाद Infinitive का Passive: Want + Object + to be V3.

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Circumstances will oblige me to go.
options: I will oblige to go by circumstances.
I shall be obliged to go.
Under circumstances I should go.
I would be obliged to go by circumstances.
answer: I shall be obliged to go.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'me' को Subject 'I' में बदलें। चरण 2: Future Indefinite 'will oblige' को 'I' के अनुसार 'shall be obliged' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'oblige' के साथ 'circumstances' को एक स्पष्ट कारण मानकर (Hidden Agent) हटा दिया जाता है। चरण 4: Infinitive 'to go' बिना किसी बदलाव के जुड़ेगा।
trick: 'will' को 'I' के साथ 'shall' में बदलना व्याकरणिक शुद्धता है, और 'by circumstances' को हटाना उन्नत Passive का हिस्सा है।
tip: Oblige के साथ Circumstances/Nature अक्सर Hidden Agents होते हैं।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: We refused them admission.
options: Admission was refused to them.
They were refused admission.
Both A and B are correct.
They refused admission by us.
answer: Both A and B are correct.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Refuse' एक Ditransitive Verb है जिसके दो Objects हैं: 'them' (Indirect) और 'admission' (Direct)। चरण 2: Indirect Object को Subject बनाने पर: 'They were refused admission.' (अधिक स्वाभाविक)। चरण 3: Direct Object को Subject बनाने पर: 'Admission was refused to them.' (यहाँ 'to' लगाना अनिवार्य है)। चरण 4: अतः दोनों रूप सही हैं।
trick: Direct Object से Passive बनाते समय Indirect Object से पहले 'to' या 'for' लगाना न भूलें।
tip: Ditransitive Verbs के दो मान्य Passive रूप होते हैं।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Please enter by the left door.
options: You are requested to enter by the left door.
Let the left door be entered.
The left door is requested to be entered.
You are ordered to enter by the left door.
answer: You are requested to enter by the left door.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Enter' यहाँ एक अकर्मक (Intransitive) क्रिया है, जिसका सीधा Passive नहीं बनता। चरण 2: 'Please' वाले Imperative वाक्यों में विनम्रता दर्शाने के लिए 'You are requested to' का प्रयोग होता है। चरण 3: 'Please' शब्द को हटा दें। चरण 4: 'enter by the left door' को 'to' के बाद ज्यों का त्यों जोड़ दें।
trick: 'Let' का प्रयोग केवल सकर्मक (Transitive) क्रियाओं वाले Imperative वाक्यों में होता है।
tip: Intransitive Imperative वाक्यों में You are requested/ordered to का प्रयोग करें।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: I know him.
options: He is known by me.
He is known to me.
He was known to me.
He has been known to me.
answer: He is known to me.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'him' को Subject 'He' में बदलें। चरण 2: Present Indefinite (know) को 'is known' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'Know' और 'Oblige' ऐसी Verbs हैं जो Passive Voice में Agent से पहले 'by' के बजाय 'to' लेती हैं। चरण 4: अतः 'by me' के स्थान पर 'to me' का प्रयोग करें।
trick: 'by me' एक बहुत ही सामान्य और खतरनाक ट्रैप है, जो पूरी तरह से गलत है।
tip: Known और Obliged हमेशा 'to' Preposition लेते हैं।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: His behavior disgusted me.
options: I was disgusted by his behavior.
I was disgusted with his behavior.
I was disgusted at his behavior.
His behavior was disgusted by me.
answer: I was disgusted with his behavior.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'me' को Subject 'I' बनाएं। चरण 2: Past Tense 'disgusted' को 'was disgusted' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'Disgust', 'Please', 'Satisfy' जैसी मानसिक या भावनात्मक स्थिति दर्शाने वाली क्रियाओं के साथ (किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति के लिए) 'with' का प्रयोग होता है। चरण 4: 'with his behavior' जोड़ें।
trick: यहाँ 'at' और 'by' गलत हैं; किसी के व्यवहार या रवैये से घृणा होने पर 'disgusted with' का प्रयोग सटीक है।
tip: Disgusted, Pleased, Satisfied के साथ 'with' का प्रयोग करें।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: It is your duty to make tea at eleven o'clock.
options: You are supposed to make tea at eleven o'clock.
Tea is to be made at eleven o'clock by you.
It is expected of you to make tea at eleven o'clock.
Both A and C are correct.
answer: Both A and C are correct.
explanation: चरण 1: 'It is your duty' दायित्व (Obligation) या अपेक्षा (Expectation) को दर्शाता है। चरण 2: ऐसे वाक्यों का Passive रूपांतरण अर्थ के आधार पर किया जाता है। चरण 3: 'You are supposed to' (A) और 'It is expected of you to' (C) दोनों ही 'duty' का सही भावार्थ देते हैं। चरण 4: Infinitive 'to make tea' अपरिवर्तित रहता है।
trick: शाब्दिक अनुवाद (Literal translation) के बजाय भावार्थ (Semantic equivalent) खोजना उच्च स्तरीय व्याकरण का हिस्सा है।
tip: Duty वाले वाक्यों को 'supposed to' या 'expected to' में बदलें।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: What did he do?
options: What was done by him?
What did done by him?
What had been done by him?
What is done by him?
answer: What was done by him?
explanation: चरण 1: Interrogative pronoun 'What' स्वयं Object है, जो Passive में Subject का कार्य करेगा। चरण 2: 'did' (Past Indefinite) को हटाकर Subject 'What' के अनुसार 'was' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 3: Main Verb 'do' का V3 'done' लगाएं। चरण 4: Subject 'he' को Agent 'by him' में बदलकर अंत में रखें।
trick: छात्र 'What' के बाद सीधे Subject खोजने लगते हैं, जबकि 'What' ही यहाँ Subject है।
tip: 'What' वाले वाक्यों में What स्वयं Passive Subject बन जाता है।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: I had him repair my car.
options: He was had to repair my car.
My car was repaired by him.
I had my car repaired by him.
I got my car to be repaired by him.
answer: I had my car repaired by him.
explanation: चरण 1: यह 'have' (Causative Verb) की संरचना है: 'Subject + have + Person + V1 + Object'। चरण 2: इसका Passive 'Subject + have + Object + V3 + by Person' होता है। चरण 3: 'I had' स्थिर रहेगा, Object 'my car' को आगे लाएं। चरण 4: Verb 'repair' को V3 'repaired' में बदलें और 'by him' जोड़ें।
trick: Causative 'have' के Passive में 'have/had' स्वयं नहीं बदलता, बल्कि उसके बाद वाला भाग 'Object + V3' में बदलता है।
tip: Causative Passive: have/get + Object + V3 + (by Agent).

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Nobody has answered my question.
options: My question has been answered by nobody.
My question has not been answered.
My question was not answered.
Nobody has been answered my question.
answer: My question has not been answered.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Nobody' एक Negative Indefinite Subject है। चरण 2: Object 'my question' को Subject बनाएं। चरण 3: 'has answered' को 'has been answered' में बदलें, लेकिन 'Nobody' की नकारात्मकता को दर्शाने के लिए 'not' जोड़ें (has not been answered)। चरण 4: 'by nobody' को व्याकरणिक रूप से भद्दा माना जाता है, इसलिए इसे हटा दें।
trick: 'by nobody' लिखना एक बड़ी भूल है; वाक्य को नकारात्मक बनाकर Agent को हटा देना चाहिए।
tip: Nobody/None को Passive में 'not' में बदलें और Agent हटा दें।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: They elected him President.
options: He was elected President by them.
President was elected to him.
He was elected as President by them.
They were elected President by him.
answer: He was elected President by them.
explanation: चरण 1: 'him' मुख्य Object है और 'President' Object Complement है। चरण 2: केवल Object (him) Subject (He) बन सकता है। चरण 3: 'elected' को 'was elected' में बदलें। चरण 4: Complement 'President' तुरंत बाद आएगा। इसके साथ 'as' का प्रयोग करना व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत है।
trick: 'Elected as President' स्पोकन इंग्लिश में आम है, लेकिन लिखित व्याकरण में 'as' का प्रयोग पूर्णतः वर्जित है।
tip: Elect, Select, Appoint के बाद Complement के साथ 'as' न लगाएं।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: The news alarmed us.
options: We were alarmed by the news.
We were alarmed at the news.
We are alarmed at the news.
The news was alarmed by us.
answer: We were alarmed at the news.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'us' को 'We' में बदलें। चरण 2: Past Indefinite 'alarmed' को 'were alarmed' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'Alarm', 'Surprise', 'Astonish' जैसी Verbs के साथ Passive में Preposition 'at' का प्रयोग होता है, 'by' का नहीं। चरण 4: अतः 'at the news' सही है।
trick: आकस्मिक घटना या समाचार से उत्पन्न भावना के लिए 'at' लगता है, 'by' वाला विकल्प ट्रैप है।
tip: Alarmed/Surprised/Shocked + at (something).

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Do not insult the weak.
options: Let the weak not be insulted.
The weak should not be insulted.
Both A and B are correct.
You are requested not to insult the weak.
answer: Both A and B are correct.
explanation: चरण 1: यह Negative Imperative वाक्य है जिसमें नैतिक सलाह (Moral advice) का भाव है। चरण 2: 'Let' का प्रयोग: 'Let + Object + not + be + V3' (Let the weak not be insulted)। चरण 3: 'Should' का प्रयोग (नैतिकता दर्शाने के लिए): 'Object + should not be + V3' (The weak should not be insulted)। चरण 4: दोनों रूप व्याकरणिक रूप से शुद्ध हैं।
trick: सामान्य आदेश के लिए 'Let' और नैतिक सलाह के लिए 'should' का प्रयोग होता है; यहाँ दोनों मान्य हैं।
tip: Negative Imperative: Let ... not be V3 या Should not be V3.

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: I have bought a house to live in.
options: A house has been bought to live in by me.
A house has been bought by me to be lived in.
To live in a house has been bought.
A house is bought to be lived in by me.
answer: A house has been bought by me to be lived in.
explanation: चरण 1: यहाँ Main Verb (have bought) और Prepositional Infinitive (to live in) दोनों हैं। चरण 2: सबसे पहले Main Clause का Passive बनाएं: 'A house has been bought by me'। चरण 3: फिर Infinitive का Passive बनाएं: 'to live' को 'to be lived' करें। चरण 4: Preposition 'in' को Verb के साथ ही रखें (to be lived in)। दोनों को जोड़ दें।
trick: केवल मुख्य क्रिया को बदलना पर्याप्त नहीं है; Infinitive का भी Passive बनाना अनिवार्य है (Advanced Grammar)।
tip: Infinitive + Preposition का Passive: to be + V3 + Preposition.

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: We must endure what we cannot cure.
options: What we cannot cure must be endured.
What cannot be cured must be endured.
What cannot cure must be endured by us.
What is not cured must be endured.
answer: What cannot be cured must be endured.
explanation: चरण 1: यह एक Complex Sentence है जिसमें Principal Clause (We must endure) और Subordinate Noun Clause (what we cannot cure) है। चरण 2: दोनों Clauses का Passive बनेगा। चरण 3: Noun Clause का Passive: 'What cannot be cured' (यहाँ 'what' subject बन गया)। चरण 4: Principal Clause का Passive: 'must be endured' ('by us' हटा दिया गया)।
trick: परीक्षा में अक्सर केवल एक भाग (आधा वाक्य) का Passive दिया जाता है; सही उत्तर में दोनों भाग Passive में होने चाहिए।
tip: Complex वाक्यों में यदि संभव हो तो दोनों Clauses का Passive बनाएं।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Prepare yourself for the worst.
options: You be prepared for the worst.
Let yourself be prepared for the worst.
Be prepared for the worst.
The worst should be prepared by you.
answer: Be prepared for the worst.
explanation: चरण 1: Reflexive Pronoun (yourself) वाले Imperative वाक्यों का विशेष नियम होता है। चरण 2: इनमें 'Let' का प्रयोग भद्दा (awkward) माना जाता है। चरण 3: 'Prepare' को सीधे 'Be + V3' (Be prepared) में बदल दिया जाता है। चरण 4: 'yourself' को हटा दें क्योंकि यह अर्थ में अंतर्निहित (implied) है, और 'for the worst' जोड़ दें।
trick: 'Let yourself be prepared' संरचना व्याकरणिक रूप से कमजोर है; 'Be prepared' सबसे मानक रूप है।
tip: Verb + Yourself (Imperative) का Passive सीधे 'Be + V3' होता है।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: We saw the tree fall.
options: The tree was seen fall by us.
The tree was seen to fall.
The tree fell and was seen.
The tree was seen falling.
answer: The tree was seen to fall.
explanation: चरण 1: Active में 'See', 'Hear', 'Make' के बाद Bare Infinitive (बिना 'to' के V1) आता है (यहाँ fall)। चरण 2: Object 'the tree' को आगे लाएं और 'saw' को 'was seen' करें। चरण 3: Passive Voice में Bare Infinitive को Full Infinitive (to + V1) में बदलना अनिवार्य है, अतः 'to fall' लिखें। चरण 4: 'by us' को हटा दें।
trick: Active में 'to' नहीं था, लेकिन Passive में 'to fall' लगाना सबसे महत्वपूर्ण नियम है, इसे भूलना आम गलती है।
tip: See/Hear + Bare Infinitive का Passive: be seen/heard + to V1.

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: They are to buy a new car.
options: A new car is to be bought by them.
A new car is being bought by them.
A new car has to be bought by them.
They have to buy a new car.
answer: A new car is to be bought by them.
explanation: चरण 1: 'is/am/are + to + V1' संरचना उद्देश्य या योजना (Infinitive of purpose) दर्शाती है। चरण 2: Object 'a new car' को Subject बनाएं। चरण 3: Singular Subject के अनुसार 'is' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 4: Infinitive 'to buy' को Passive 'to be bought' में बदलें और 'by them' जोड़ें।
trick: इसे Continuous Tense समझकर 'being bought' चुनना सबसे बड़ी गलती है; यह Infinitive का सीधा रूपांतरण है।
tip: be (is/am/are) + to V1 को be + to be V3 में बदलें।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: It is impossible to do this.
options: This is impossible to be done.
To do this is impossible.
It is impossible for this to be done.
This impossible is to be done.
answer: This is impossible to be done.
explanation: चरण 1: 'It is + Adjective + to V1 + Object' संरचना है। चरण 2: Infinitive के Object 'this' को पूरे वाक्य का Subject बना लें। चरण 3: 'is impossible' को उसके बाद ज्यों का त्यों रखें। चरण 4: Active Infinitive 'to do' को Passive Infinitive 'to be done' में बदलें।
trick: यद्यपि 'It is impossible for this to be done' भी बन सकता है, लेकिन 'This is impossible to be done' सबसे संक्षिप्त और मानक रूप है।
tip: It is + Adj + to V1 + Obj = Obj + is + Adj + to be V3.

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Who taught you French?
options: By whom were you taught French?
By who were you taught French?
Who were you taught French by?
Both A and C are correct.
answer: Both A and C are correct.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Who' वाले प्रश्नवाचक वाक्यों को दो तरह से Passive में बदला जा सकता है। चरण 2: पारंपरिक रूप: 'Who' को 'By whom' में बदलकर वाक्य के शुरू में रखें (By whom were you taught French?)। चरण 3: आधुनिक रूप: 'Who' को शुरू में ही रखें और Preposition 'by' को वाक्य के अंत में ले जाएं (Who were you taught French by?)। चरण 4: अतः दोनों विकल्प सही हैं।
trick: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में अब अक्सर 'Who ... by' वाला विकल्प सही माना जाता है, इसलिए दोनों की जानकारी आवश्यक है।
tip: Who का Passive 'By whom' या 'Who ... by' दोनों से बन सकता है।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: One should not mock at the poor.
options: The poor should not be mocked.
The poor should not be mocked at.
The poor should not been mocked at by one.
The poor should not mock at.
answer: The poor should not be mocked at.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Mock at' एक Prepositional Verb (Phrasal Verb) है। चरण 2: Object 'the poor' को Subject बनाएं। चरण 3: 'should not' के साथ 'be + V3' (be mocked) लगाएं। चरण 4: सबसे महत्वपूर्ण: Verb के साथ जुड़े Preposition 'at' को न हटाएं। अंत में 'One' को (Indefinite Pronoun) हटा दें।
trick: Preposition 'at' को हटा देना एक बहुत आम गलती है; क्रिया का अर्थ बनाए रखने के लिए यह आवश्यक है।
tip: Prepositional Verbs का Preposition Passive में हमेशा साथ रहता है।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: He likes people to call him 'Sir'.
options: He likes to be called 'Sir' by people.
He likes being called 'Sir'.
He likes to be called 'Sir'.
Both B and C are correct, but C matches the active infinitive structure better.
answer: Both B and C are correct, but C matches the active infinitive structure better.
explanation: चरण 1: Active वाक्य में Infinitive 'to call' है और 'He' तथा 'him' एक ही व्यक्ति हैं। चरण 2: इसका सीधा Passive 'to be called' होगा: 'He likes to be called Sir' (Infinitive Passive)। चरण 3: 'Like' Verb Gerund भी ले सकती है, इसलिए 'He likes being called Sir' (Gerund Passive) भी अर्थपूर्ण है। चरण 4: 'by people' को हटा दें। अतः B और C दोनों व्याकरण सम्मत हैं।
trick: 'Like/Love' Verbs के साथ Infinitive और Gerund दोनों के Passive रूप (to be V3 / being V3) मान्य होते हैं।
tip: Like/Love + to be V3 या being V3 दोनों सही हैं।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: A storm damaged the roof.
options: The roof was damaged by a storm.
The roof was damaged in a storm.
The roof had been damaged by a storm.
Both A and B are acceptable in modern English.
answer: Both A and B are acceptable in modern English.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'the roof' को Subject बनाएं और 'was damaged' लिखें। चरण 2: सामान्यतः Agent के लिए 'by a storm' का प्रयोग होता है (जो सही है)। चरण 3: हालांकि, प्राकृतिक आपदाओं (storm, earthquake) को अक्सर एक परिस्थिति (circumstance) माना जाता है, इसलिए 'in a storm' भी व्यापक रूप से स्वीकार्य और स्वाभाविक है। चरण 4: अतः दोनों मान्य हैं।
trick: प्राकृतिक घटनाओं के लिए 'in' का प्रयोग 'by' से अधिक स्वाभाविक माना जाता है, यद्यपि 'by' तकनीकी रूप से गलत नहीं है।
tip: प्राकृतिक आपदाओं के साथ Agent 'by' या 'in' दोनों ले सकता है।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Your prompt reply will highly oblige me.
options: I will be highly obliged by your prompt reply.
I shall be highly obliged to your prompt reply.
I shall be highly obliged by your prompt reply.
I shall be highly obliged at your prompt reply.
answer: I shall be highly obliged by your prompt reply.
explanation: चरण 1: 'me' को 'I' में बदलें। 'I' के साथ Future Tense में 'shall' का प्रयोग व्याकरणिक रूप से अधिक शुद्ध है (shall be obliged)। चरण 2: 'Oblige' के साथ Preposition का नियम: यदि कोई व्यक्ति (Person) हो, तो 'to' लगता है। चरण 3: यदि कोई वस्तु या कार्य (reply) हो, तो 'by' का प्रयोग होता है। चरण 4: यहाँ 'reply' कार्य है, इसलिए 'by' सही है।
trick: 'Obliged to' रटा हुआ होता है, लेकिन वह व्यक्ति के लिए है। निर्जीव या कार्य के लिए 'by' ही आता है।
tip: Obliged to a person; Obliged by a thing/action.

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: We expect that they will win the match.
options: It is expected that they will win the match.
It is expected that the match will be won by them.
They are expected to win the match.
All of the above are correct passive forms.
answer: All of the above are correct passive forms.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Verbs of belief/expectation' + that-clause के कई Passive बनते हैं। चरण 2: Impersonal Passive (केवल Main clause): 'It is expected that they will win the match.' चरण 3: Double Passive (दोनों clauses): 'It is expected that the match will be won by them.' चरण 4: Personal Passive (Subordinate subject को आगे लाकर): 'They are expected to win the match.' सभी पूर्णतः सही हैं।
trick: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में अक्सर Personal Passive (They are expected to...) को सबसे उन्नत माना जाता है, लेकिन अन्य भी सही हैं।
tip: Expect/Believe + that-clause के तीन मान्य Passive रूप होते हैं।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: The child's performance fascinated them.
options: They were fascinated by the child's performance.
They were fascinated with the child's performance.
They were fascinated at the child's performance.
Both B and C are correct.
answer: Both B and C are correct.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'them' को Subject 'They' बनाएं। 'fascinated' को 'were fascinated' करें। चरण 2: 'Fascinate', 'Charm', 'Amaze' जैसी Verbs के साथ 'by' का प्रयोग कम होता है। चरण 3: व्यक्ति के लिए 'with' और किसी प्रदर्शन/चीज़ के लिए 'at' या 'with' का प्रयोग होता है। चरण 4: यहाँ 'performance' के लिए 'with' या 'at' दोनों स्वीकार्य हैं।
trick: 'by' का प्रयोग ऐसी मानसिक प्रभाव वाली क्रियाओं के साथ गलत माना जाता है।
tip: Fascinated/Charmed takes 'with' (person/thing) or 'at' (thing).

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: He gave me a pen to write with.
options: I was given a pen by him to write with.
A pen was given to me by him to write with.
A pen to write with was given to me by him.
All of the above.
answer: All of the above.
explanation: चरण 1: वाक्य में Indirect Object (me), Direct Object (a pen) और Prepositional Infinitive (to write with) है। चरण 2: Indirect से: 'I was given a pen... to write with.' चरण 3: Direct से: 'A pen was given to me... to write with.' चरण 4: Infinitive को Noun के साथ रखकर: 'A pen to write with was given...'। सभी संरचनाएं सही हैं।
trick: Prepositional Infinitive (to write with) एक Adjective Phrase की तरह 'pen' के साथ भी जुड़ सकता है और वाक्य के अंत में भी आ सकता है।
tip: Ditransitive verbs + Infinitive के कई लचीले (flexible) Passive रूप होते हैं।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Has someone made all the necessary arrangements?
options: Have all the necessary arrangements been made by someone?
Has all the necessary arrangements been made?
Have all the necessary arrangements been made?
Are all the necessary arrangements made?
answer: Have all the necessary arrangements been made?
explanation: चरण 1: यह Present Perfect Interrogative वाक्य है। Object 'all the necessary arrangements' (Plural) है। चरण 2: Plural Subject के लिए 'Has' की जगह 'Have' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 3: 'been + made' लगाएं (Have ... been made?)। चरण 4: 'someone' एक Indefinite Agent है, जिसे Passive में पूरी तरह से हटा देना चाहिए।
trick: शुरुआत 'Has' से देखकर छात्र 'Has' ही चुन लेते हैं, लेकिन नया Subject Plural होने पर Helping Verb बदलनी चाहिए।
tip: नये Subject के वचन (Singular/Plural) के अनुसार Helping Verb बदलें।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: I remember them taking me to the zoo.
options: I remember being taken to the zoo.
I remember to be taken to the zoo.
I remember I was taken to the zoo.
Taking me to the zoo is remembered.
answer: I remember being taken to the zoo.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Taking' यहाँ एक Gerund है। चरण 2: Gerund का Passive हमेशा 'being + V3' (being taken) होता है। चरण 3: 'I remember' मुख्य उपवाक्य है, जिसे ज्यों का त्यों रखा जाता है। चरण 4: 'them' एक सामान्य Agent है, इसलिए 'by them' लगाने की कोई आवश्यकता नहीं है। इसे हटा दें।
trick: यहाँ 'them' को Object मानकर क्लॉज बदलने की गलती न करें; केवल Gerund को Passive में बदलें और agent हटाएँ।
tip: Gerund (v-ing) का Passive 'being + V3' है, Agent (them) हटा दें।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Let him do this work.
options: Let this work be done by him.
Let this work done by him.
This work should be done by him.
Let him be done this work.
answer: Let this work be done by him.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Let' से शुरू होने वाले Imperative वाक्यों (जिनमें अनुमति या आदेश हो) का एक विशिष्ट नियम है। चरण 2: संरचना 'Let + Direct Object + be + V3 + by + Indirect Object' होती है। चरण 3: Object 'this work' को Let के बाद लाएं। चरण 4: 'be done' लगाएं और अंत में 'by him' जोड़ें।
trick: अक्सर छात्र 'be' लगाना भूल जाते हैं या 'should' वाला विकल्प चुन लेते हैं, जबकि 'Let' के साथ 'be' अनिवार्य है।
tip: Let + Object + be + V3 + by Agent.

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Rose smells sweet.
options: Rose is sweet when it smells.
Rose is sweet when it is smelt.
Rose is smelt sweet.
Rose was sweet when smelt.
answer: Rose is sweet when it is smelt.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Smell' एक Stative Verb है जो Adjective (sweet) ले रही है। चरण 2: नियम: 'Subject + is/are + Adjective + when it is / they are + V3'। चरण 3: 'Rose is sweet' लिखें। चरण 4: 'when it is' जोड़कर 'smell' का V3 'smelt' (या smelled) लगाएं।
trick: सीधा 'is smelt sweet' गलत है, 'when it is' क्लॉज लगाना अनिवार्य है।
tip: Stative Verb + Adjective = S + be + Adj + when it is + V3.

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: The judge found him guilty of murder.
options: He was found guilty of murder by the judge.
Guilty of murder was found by the judge.
He was found to be guilty of murder by the judge.
The judge was found guilty of murder.
answer: He was found guilty of murder by the judge.
explanation: चरण 1: 'him' (Object) को Subject 'He' बनाएं। चरण 2: 'guilty of murder' यहाँ Object Complement है, यह अपनी जगह (Verb के बाद) ही रहेगा। चरण 3: 'found' (Past) को 'was found' करें। चरण 4: 'guilty of murder' जोड़कर अंत में Agent 'by the judge' लगाएं।
trick: Complement 'guilty' को Subject बनाने की भूल न करें; केवल मुख्य Object ही Subject बनता है।
tip: Object Complement (guilty) Passive में Verb के बाद ही रहता है।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: They are building a new bridge across the river.
options: A new bridge is being built across the river.
Across the river a new bridge is being built by them.
A new bridge across the river is being built.
Both A and C are grammatically acceptable, with Agent 'they' omitted.
answer: Both A and C are grammatically acceptable, with Agent 'they' omitted.
explanation: चरण 1: Present Continuous Tense। Object 'a new bridge' है, और 'across the river' Prepositional Phrase है। चरण 2: Phrase को Object के साथ जोड़ा जा सकता है (A new bridge across the river is being built)। चरण 3: या Phrase को अंत में रखा जा सकता है (A new bridge is being built across the river)। चरण 4: 'They' (Hidden Agent) को हटा दिया गया है। दोनों रूप मान्य हैं।
trick: Prepositional Place Phrases (across the river) की स्थिति लचीली (flexible) होती है।
tip: Place Phrases को Subject के साथ या वाक्य के अंत में रखा जा सकता है।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: One cannot gather grapes from thistles.
options: Grapes cannot be gathered from thistles.
Grapes cannot be gathered by one from thistles.
From thistles grapes cannot be gathered.
Thistles cannot be gathered from grapes.
answer: Grapes cannot be gathered from thistles.
explanation: चरण 1: 'One' एक Indefinite Pronoun है जिसे Passive में हटा दिया जाता है। चरण 2: Object 'grapes' को Subject बनाएं। चरण 3: Modal 'cannot' के साथ 'be + V3' (cannot be gathered) का प्रयोग करें। चरण 4: Prepositional phrase 'from thistles' को अंत में ज्यों का त्यों जोड़ दें।
trick: 'by one' लिखना अनावश्यक और व्याकरणिक रूप से कमजोर है, इसे हमेशा हटाएं।
tip: सामान्य सत्यों (Proverbs/General Truths) में Indefinite Agent हटा दें।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: We must respect the elders.
options: The elders must be respected by us.
The elders must be respected.
The elders are respected.
Respect must be given to the elders.
answer: The elders must be respected.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'the elders' को Subject बनाएं। चरण 2: Modal 'must' को 'must be + V3' (must be respected) में बदलें। चरण 3: 'We' यहाँ एक सामान्य समूह (Universal Agent) को दर्शाता है। चरण 4: अतः 'by us' को हटा देना (Hidden Agent) सबसे सटीक और मानक तरीका है।
trick: हालांकि 'by us' तकनीकी रूप से गलत नहीं है, लेकिन नैतिक कर्तव्यों वाले वाक्यों में इसे हटाना ही Advanced Grammar का नियम है।
tip: नैतिक दायित्वों में सामान्य कर्ता (We/People) को हटा दें।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: Women use cosmetics to look beautiful.
options: Cosmetics are used by women to look beautiful.
Cosmetics are used to look beautiful by women.
To look beautiful, cosmetics are used by women.
All of the above.
answer: All of the above.
explanation: चरण 1: मुख्य क्लॉज 'Women use cosmetics' को 'Cosmetics are used by women' में बदलें। चरण 2: 'to look beautiful' एक Adverbial of Purpose (उद्देश्य सूचक) है। चरण 3: Adverbials को वाक्य के शुरू में, मध्य में (verb के बाद) या अंत में रखा जा सकता है। चरण 4: अतः दिए गए तीनों विकल्प व्याकरणिक रूप से पूरी तरह सही और मान्य हैं।
trick: उद्देश्य सूचक Infinitive (to + V1) की स्थिति (Position) वाक्य का अर्थ नहीं बदलती, यह लचीली होती है।
tip: Adverbial of Purpose की स्थिति (Position) वाक्य में कहीं भी हो सकती है।

question: Identify the correct passive voice transformation for the following sentence: They say he is a spy.
options: It is said that he is a spy.
He is said to be a spy.
Both A and B are correct.
A spy is said to be him.
answer: Both A and B are correct.
explanation: चरण 1: 'They say' (Verbs of Reporting) वाले वाक्यों के दो मान्य Passive होते हैं। चरण 2: पहला (Impersonal): 'It' को dummy subject बनाकर 'It is said that he is a spy' लिखें। चरण 3: दूसरा (Personal): Subordinate subject 'he' को आगे लाकर Infinitive का प्रयोग करें: 'He is said to be a spy'। चरण 4: अतः A और B दोनों रूप पूर्णतः सही हैं।
trick: Personal Passive (He is said...) को समझना थोड़ा कठिन है, लेकिन यह औपचारिक अंग्रेजी (Formal English) का सबसे पसंदीदा रूप है।
tip: Verbs of Reporting (Say/Believe/Report) के दो Passive रूप बनते हैं।
